newsitem.title: USA: D&P reaffirms Aon senior debt rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P reaffirms Aon senior debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said on Monday it has reaffirmed the senior debt rating of Aon Corp at double-A following its acquisition of Bain Hogg Group from Inchcape Plc.

D&P said terms of the deal are firmly within its expectations, with the $251 million transaction funded by a portion of the $1.2 billion of proceeds generated from the sale of The Life Insurance Co of Virginia and Union Fidelity Life Insurance Co in March 1996.

Bain Hogg is currently the 11th largest insurance broker in the world, producing $346 million of revenue in 1995. Following the transaction, Aon will become the largest insurance broker in the United Kingdom and the Far East, in addition to having an expanded market presence in continental Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean.

The current rating reflects Aon's well-defined market position and strong operating fundamentals, including multiple revenue sources, conservative balance sheet quality, moderate debt levels and solid fixed-charge coverage ratios, D&P said in a statement.
